study type: Observational retrospective study applying causal inference techniques
cohort: The study included patients diagnosed with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) at a major Irish maternity hospital.
finding: The study successfully applied structure learning techniques to observational clinical data to identify and quantify critical causal pathways in GDM management, enhancing clinicians' confidence in patient care strategies.
mod_finding: Sensitivity analysis confirmed that mode of delivery is a major determinant of maternal and neonatal outcomes in GDM patients.
